name: rdloom-monorepo
description: Spec-driven UI components. One spec, every surface.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/react --noEmit && tsc -p examples/components && tsc -p apps/docs
scripts.build: npm run gen && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tools && npm run test:unit
scripts.dev: npm run gen && npm run dev -w @rdloom/playground
scripts.test: npm run gen --silent && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --root packages/react && vitest run --root packages/cli && vitest run --root packages/mcp && vitest run --root packages/figma
scripts.docs: npm run gen && npm run dev -w @rdloom/docs
